indicvoices.name: IndicVoices (AI4Bharat), Hindi long-form release
indicvoices.attribution: Javed T. et al., "IndicVoices: Towards building an Inclusive Multilingual Speech Dataset for Indian Languages", ACL Findings 2024 (arXiv 2403.01926). AI4Bharat, funded by Bhashini, MeitY and Nilekani Philanthropies. CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
indicvoices.why: HF card: license cc-by-4.0, click-through gate with no extra terms. INFERRED: the dmu_release long-form archives carry the same licence (they have no licence file; W1 open question 1).

spring-inx.name: SPRING-INX Hindi (SPRING Lab, IIT Madras)
spring-inx.attribution: Nithya R. et al., "SPRING-INX: A Multilingual Indian Language Speech Corpus by SPRING Lab, IIT Madras" (arXiv 2310.14654). Funded by MeitY. CC BY 4.0.
spring-inx.why: "released under CCBY 4.0 license", read from the asr.iitm.ac.in JS bundle (the page is a SPA, no stable licence URL); CC BY 4.0 on AIKosh for other languages (W1).

vaani.name: Vaani (ARTPARK / IISc), Hindi
vaani.why: CC BY 4.0 HF tag on Vaani and Vaani-transcription-part (gated auto + form). Attribution text not yet written (W1).

mucs-slr103.name: MUCS 2021 Hindi (OpenSLR SLR103)
mucs-slr103.why: Licence UNVERIFIED: OpenSLR links only msropendata-web-api.azurewebsites.net/licenses/f1f352a6…, which no longer resolves (2026-10-14); MS O-UDA per the W1 task file. W1 verdict: reject on content (read, short).

rural-women.name: Rural Women ASR v2 (AI4Bharat)
rural-women.why: CC BY 4.0 in the README Licensing section (no metadata tag); consent statement UNVERIFIED.

kathbath.name: Kathbath (AI4Bharat), Hindi
kathbath.why: Licence conflict between mirrors; take the stricter (SA) until resolved (research/datasets.md finding 4).

lahaja.name: Lahaja (AI4Bharat)
lahaja.licence: CC BY 4.0 (card text); HF metadata tag MIT
lahaja.why: A benchmark: kept out of Part A as W8c's accent-diverse eval set.

fleurs.name: FLEURS hi_in (Google)
fleurs.why: Read single-utterance files; the only open Hi→En S2ST eval set.

indicvoices-r.name: IndicVoices-R (AI4Bharat)
indicvoices-r.why: Same speech as IndicVoices, enhanced into new files: cutting from both would double-count hours (§3A union is per source file).

gram-vaani.name: Gram Vaani (OpenSLR SLR118)
gram-vaani.why: "used freely for academic purposes, but permission for any commercial use… contact@gramvaani.org": the recipient is a company (§10 R1).

shrutilipi.name: Shrutilipi (AI4Bharat)
shrutilipi.licence: CC BY 4.0 (card); AIR audio needs NSD prior written permission
shrutilipi.why: All India Radio news audio; newsonair's copyright policy requires prior written permission beyond personal non-commercial use.

yodas.name: YODAS / YODAS2 hi000 (ESPnet)
yodas.why: Only the uploader granted the licence, not the speakers: fails consent compliance (§3A); captions unreliable.
